q: The pilgrimage to the holy Ka'bah in Makkah performed by Muslims once in a lifetime if able is ____. (P4)
explain: Hajj is the fifth pillar of Islam during the month of Dhul-Hijjah.

q: The cube-shaped sacred building in the center of the Grand Mosque in Makkah is the ____. (P4)
explain: The Ka'bah is the Qiblah (direction of prayer) for all Muslims worldwide.

q: The angel who delivered divine revelations from Allah to the prophets was Angel ____. (P4)

q: Surah Al-Ikhlas (Qur'an 112) powerfully proclaims the absolute oneness and uniqueness of ____. (P4)
explain: Surah Al-Ikhlas declares: 'Say, He is Allah, [who is] One.'

q: Prophetic history (P4): Who was Prophet Isa (AS) in Islamic heritage?

q: Prophetic history (P4): Who was Prophet Nuh (AS) in Islamic heritage?
